args.recommendation: The department should review and update the algorithmic impact assessment of the automated decision system to ensure it complies with the Directive on Automated Decision-Making. Additionally, the department should ensure that recourse options for clients are timely, effective, and easy to access, as per Section 6.4 of the Directive. Furthermore, the department should consult with legal services from the concept stage of any automation project to ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements, as per Section 6.3.12 of the Directive. Finally, the department should ensure that human involvement is maintained in the automated decision system, as per Section 6.3.13 of the Directive.
